svg.title: Track (tp::track): the soil along the track, sampled at setup

g.text: Track (tp::track): the soil along the track, sampled at setup
+at(x_m, y_m) : double, 0 to the spot's peak
x from the start line (the sled's rear wheels at the start);
profiles hold their end values beyond their ends;
in the step: a lookup and a blend of two samples, no soil model;
hard and weak spots laid from their seeds at setup (xorshift), the
same on every platform, over the first 200 m, each somewhere across
the lane (any line as likely to cross one): surface_at() evaluates
the spot under (x, y) exactly (a binary search along x): a hard spot
raises the drag_scale, a weak spot lowers the grip_factor;
surface_across() takes their mean over a width (the sled's pan)
